Proposed next steps:
- We will issue a provisional service credit for the full charge while Finance finalizes the credit note.
- Ben is pulling the ledger entries and Marissa will prepare the credit note and VAT evidence you can use for your records.
- I’ll follow up with a DocuSign if we need the termination acknowledgement appended to finalize the accounting.

Appreciate the patience — we’ll make this right.
